requirement: EmDash first-run uses the right site address on a bridged host

oracle.invariant: An ordinary host POSTs setup over loopback; a bridged host POSTs to the site container's own IP. If the IP cannot be determined, setup is not POSTed and no token is minted.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: generic: a clean mint stores the PAT and reports ready
generic: first-run setup reaches the site on a bridged host
generic: an unknown site address fails before setup or mint
generic: a NONZERO mint with valid-looking stdout FAILS (status is not `|| true`d away)
generic: a malformed / missing PAT on stdout FAILS
generic: raw mint output never reaches the log
generic: a directory at the destination FAILS the write (the confirmed bug, via post_up)
generic: a symlink at the destination is REFUSED
generic: a failed root chown FAILS the store (permission step not swallowed, no non-root skip)
generic: a chown that "succeeds" but leaves a non-root owner FAILS (owner is verified)
generic: a failed mint-helper copy FAILS before minting
relay: a labelled image on the generic path registers the relay token, digest and identity
relay: an image without the label keeps the old first-run path (no relay step)
relay: a failed relay registration on the generic path FAILS the provision
relay: a labelled business image still registers the relay (once)
business: a clean bootstrap collects the PAT, cleans up, and reports ready
business: a failed bootstrap FAILS (full bootstrap failure prevents ready)
business: raw bootstrap output (even a fake PAT) never reaches the provision log
business: an invalid legacy token FAILS the store
business: a symlinked / non-regular legacy token in the container is REFUSED
business: a failed legacy cleanup FAILS — no readable copy may be left behind
business: cleanup that leaves the copy present (verify fails) FAILS
business: an exec error during the absence check is NOT read as "gone"
provision.sh takes --mail-sender (tracy-host sends it for a demo or a stock instance)
mail (macOS stack): no loopback answer — the helper dials the web container address docker reports
mail (macOS stack): an address docker cannot report, or one that is not an IPv4, FAILS before the helper
mail: a site that answers on loopback is never asked for its docker address
mail: a failed mint never reaches the mail step
mail: a failed image inspect FAILS before the mail step
mail (demo through provision.sh): a framed demo is configured, and one without the shim still FAILS
mail (demo through deploy-quickstart.sh): no mail step on that road, and it says the demo mails nobody
